items.title: OtherLife
items.reason: Neural technology, altered time perception, experiments, and escalating implications.

items.title: Minor Premise
items.reason: A neuroscientist fractures his own consciousness and has to scientifically unravel what he did.

items.title: I Origins
items.reason: A molecular biologist finds evidence that pushes ordinary biological research into impossible territory.

items.title: Synchronic
items.reason: Bizarre incidents lead to a drug whose effects on time have to be tested and understood.

items.title: Time Lapse
items.reason: A machine photographs the future; the suspense comes from discovering and exploiting its rules.

items.title: I Am Mother
items.reason: A bunker, an AI mother, a human experiment, and the growing suspicion that the entire setup means something else.

items.title: Sputnik
items.reason: Scientists study a cosmonaut who returned from space with an unknown organism living inside him.

items.title: The Thing
items.reason: Researchers investigate an alien organism that assimilates and perfectly imitates other life.

items.title: The Andromeda Strain
items.reason: A scientific team in a specialized laboratory investigates a lethal extraterrestrial microorganism.

items.title: Blood Glacier
items.reason: Scientists encounter a red biological substance producing bizarre genetic effects in Alpine wildlife.

items.title: Sea Fever
items.reason: A marine-biology expedition encounters an unknown organism and has to understand its parasitic effects.

items.title: Mimic
items.reason: An engineered insect species evolves in ways its geneticist creators never intended.

items.title: Source Code
items.reason: An impossible repeated eight-minute window becomes both a murder investigation and a mystery about the technology itself.

items.title: Déjà Vu
items.reason: A bombing investigation opens into experimental surveillance technology with much stranger implications.

items.title: Mirage
items.reason: A strange storm connects two time periods and rewrites reality around a murder mystery.

items.title: Exam
items.reason: Eight candidates must deduce the hidden rules of a seemingly impossible job exam.

items.title: Escape Room
items.reason: A lethal sequence of puzzle rooms hides a larger question about why these people were selected.

items.title: Identity
items.reason: A motel murder mystery becomes increasingly impossible as the connections between its strangers emerge.

items.title: Old
items.reason: People trapped on a beach age at an impossible rate and must determine why this place works differently.

items.title: Radius
items.reason: A man wakes after an accident and discovers that people inexplicably die when they get near him.

items.title: The Forgotten
items.reason: A mother remembers a child everyone else insists never existed, and the evidence itself begins changing.

items.title: Frequency
items.reason: An atmospheric anomaly allows communication across decades and turns into a two-time-period investigation.

items.title: The Call
items.reason: Two women in the same house but different decades discover they can rewrite each other's lives.

items.title: Predestination
items.reason: A temporal investigation keeps folding identity, causality, and its own premise back onto itself.

items.title: Triangle
items.reason: A mysterious ship and repeating events turn a survival setup into a reality-rule puzzle.

items.title: Coherence
items.reason: A comet triggers reality-bending events whose rules the characters have to deduce in real time.

items.title: The Signal
items.reason: A hacker trail ends in a suspicious research facility where every explanation creates another question.

items.title: Pandorum
items.reason: Amnesiac crew members wake aboard an apparently abandoned ship and slowly reconstruct what happened.

items.title: No One Will Save You
items.reason: An alien encounter escalates quickly into increasingly strange behavior and implications.

items.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
items.reason: A bunker mystery where the central suspense is whether the catastrophe outside is real and who is lying.

items.title: Dark City
items.reason: A man investigates a city whose memories, architecture, and very rules of reality keep changing.

items.title: Cuckoo
items.reason: A resort in the Alps hides a bizarre phenomenon involving behavior, reproduction, and biology.

items.title: Ash
items.reason: A woman wakes on an alien planet with her station crew dead and her own memories unreliable.

items.title: The Mist
items.reason: A sudden unnatural mist contains organisms that should not exist and traps a town in an unexplained event.

items.title: Knowing
items.reason: A scientist decodes numbers that accurately predict disasters, including events that have not happened yet.

items.title: Sphere
items.reason: Scientists investigate an impossible object under the ocean while reality around them starts behaving strangely.

items.title: Event Horizon
items.reason: A vanished experimental spacecraft returns years later after apparently going somewhere impossible.

items.title: Life
items.reason: ISS scientists study the first Martian organism and discover its biology is far more capable than expected.

items.title: The Faculty
items.reason: Students investigate teachers whose increasingly abnormal behavior points to a spreading organism.

items.title: The Cloverfield Paradox
items.reason: A particle-accelerator experiment makes Earth disappear and triggers impossible events aboard a station.
An astronomical anomaly causes partygoers to encounter an increasingly disturbing duplication phenomenon.

items.title: ARQ
items.reason: A home invasion is trapped in a time loop whose origin and rules keep changing the situation.

items.title: Infini
items.reason: A rescue team enters an off-world station after a biological outbreak and encounters a very strange life-form.

items.title: Splinter
items.reason: A parasitic organism reanimates and reshapes tissue in ways the trapped survivors must understand.

items.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
items.reason: A detective investigates identical murders recurring nine years apart despite an apparently impossible suspect.
items.canonical_title: In the Shadow of the Moon

items.title: Banshee Chapter
items.reason: A journalist follows a chemical experiment, government research, strange transmissions, and people changing.

items.title: The Thirteenth Floor
items.reason: A murder investigation collides with a simulated reality whose inhabitants believe they are real.

items.title: Fermat's Room
items.reason: Mathematicians must solve puzzles while a room physically shrinks around them and their shared past emerges.

items.title: The Killing Room
items.reason: Volunteers discover that a paid research study is actually a lethal psychological experiment.

items.title: Devil
items.reason: Five people are trapped in an elevator while impossible attacks occur whenever the lights go out.

items.title: The Belko Experiment
items.reason: Office workers are sealed inside their building and forced into a controlled social experiment.

items.title: The Menu
items.reason: An elaborate dinner reveals itself as a carefully designed system built around the specific guests.

items.title: The Girl with All the Gifts
items.reason: Scientists study children altered by a fungal infection that may represent a new biological state.
items.canonical_title: The Girl with All the Gifts

items.title: Splice
items.reason: Genetic engineers create a hybrid organism whose rapidly developing traits keep surprising its creators.

items.title: Europa Report
items.reason: A scientific expedition to Europa follows evidence of possible life beneath the moon's ice.

items.title: Morgan
items.reason: A corporate specialist evaluates a synthetic human after a lab-created organism begins behaving unpredictably.

items.title: The Bay
items.reason: Recovered footage reconstructs a bizarre ecological and parasitic outbreak in a coastal town.

items.title: Limitless
items.reason: A cognitive-enhancing drug radically expands what its user can do, then exposes the cost and larger network around it.

items.title: Transcendence
items.reason: An AI researcher's consciousness becomes digital and its capabilities rapidly expand into technology and biology.

items.title: The Substance
items.reason: A biomedical treatment creates a younger duplicate body with strict rules and escalating biological consequences.

items.title: The Titan
items.reason: Scientists genetically alter humans so their bodies can survive the environment of Titan.

items.title: Infinity Chamber
items.reason: An automated prison repeatedly manipulates a detainee's experiences while he tries to understand the system.

items.title: Possessor
items.reason: Neural technology lets an assassin inhabit other bodies until the line between minds starts breaking down.

items.title: The Assessment
items.reason: A couple undergoes a tightly controlled seven-day evaluation to determine whether they may have a child.

items.title: Mickey 17
items.reason: A disposable human worker can be reprinted after death, forcing the premise into identity and biology questions.

items.title: Companion
items.reason: A high-concept sci-fi setup keeps revealing new layers instead of relying on a single twist.

items.title: Arrival
items.reason: Seen — top notch; scientists, alien language, discovery, and enormous conceptual implications.

items.title: Annihilation
items.reason: Seen — top notch; bizarre biology, mutation, scientists, and an evolving unknown phenomenon.

items.title: Lucy
items.reason: Seen — loved; a synthetic substance pushes an escalating brain-capacity premise to its extreme.

items.title: The Platform
items.reason: Seen — liked; a bizarre artificial system with rules, hierarchy, and a mystery about why it exists.

items.title: Circle
items.reason: Seen — liked; strangers discover and test the rules of an unknown lethal system.

items.title: Cube
items.reason: Seen — good; puzzle structure, hidden rules, mathematics, and survival through understanding the system.

items.title: Cube 2: Hypercube
items.reason: Seen — good; the Cube concept expands into stranger physics and dimensional rules.

items.title: Spectral
items.reason: Seen — interesting, but the mystery eventually becomes more military-action oriented.

items.title: Underwater
items.reason: Seen — interesting but boring for you because it mostly becomes escape-the-monsters/catastrophe.

items.title: Weapons
items.reason: Seen — definitely strange, but a little boring because it circles the mystery more than it escalates.

items.title: Saw
items.reason: Seen — not a strong fit; more psychological horror than the kind of scientific mystery you want.

items.title: The Platform 2
items.reason: Seen — boring for you because it mostly repeats the first movie's concept instead of giving you a fresh phenomenon.

items.title: Fringe
items.reason: Reference series — all-time favorite; scientists investigate impossible phenomena, biological anomalies, experiments, conspiracies and escalating mysteries.
